notes: Coordinated disclosure record: reports accepted under the Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Policy, published once remediated and the coordination window has closed. Edit this file in the repository and commit; the Trust Center reads it on the next page load. Plain text only, it is escaped on render. severity must be Critical, High, Medium, Low or Informational. Publish a researcher's name in credit only with their consent.
cvdRecordIntro: Every report accepted through our Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Policy is recorded here once it is remediated and the coordination window has closed: what was reported, how it was scored, when it was fixed, and who reported it. We publish the record whether or not a finding was ours to be proud of, because a disclosure page that only ever shows good news tells a reviewer nothing.
